summary: Frontend-only regression test verifying total removal of the Rigid mascot system. All acceptance criteria PASS. Filesystem grep for 'rigid'|'mascot' (case-insensitive) in /app/frontend/src and /app/frontend/public returns zero hits. All five target routes (/, /browse, /forums, /terms, /designer/new) render without crashes, red webpack overlays, or module-not-found errors. Zero rigid/mascot DOM elements across all pages. Zero rigid/mascot/pngtree/sprite console errors or 4xx network responses. Terms Section 5 correctly reads 'Moderation & Enforcement' with no residual 'Rigid' text in body. Browse empty state ('Nothing here yet / Be the first to list') and Forums empty state ('No forum posts found in this section yet. Be the first to start a thread.') both show clean text-only layouts with no mascot avatar reserved space. No fixed-position blocking overlay with z-index near 110 anywhere (RigidWarningGate confirmed removed). 3D Editor at /designer/new mounts canvas (1500x976) with no THREE errors — regression PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Cleanup is complete and surgical — no dead imports, dead CSS classes, or orphaned data-testids remain.

Backend endpoints /api/launch-tour/complete and /api/enforcement/acknowledge are dormant no-ops per problem statement; if they will never be re-used they can be deleted in a future backend cleanup pass, but this is not blocking.
Empty-state components on Browse and Forums now render clean text-only layouts — good visual balance, no residual space reserved for the removed mascot.
test_credentials: None used (guest-only testing per problem statement).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rigid mascot removal is fully verified and complete. No follow-up needed on this feature. If future changes reintroduce any /components/Rigid*.jsx file, /public/rigid-mascot-sprite.*, or .rigid-mascot-* CSS class, this test flow (grep + 5 routes + Terms Section 5 check + Browse/Forums empty state + editor canvas + warning-gate overlay scan) can be reused as regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a subtractive verification, no bug to RCA. Prior iteration_2 flagged a 403 hotlink issue on pngtree.com; user chose full removal instead of local hosting; that decision is now verified to be cleanly implemented.
